title: Quantile-driven token-saturation probe and graceful-degradation policy for VPC workers
creator: Priya Nair
description: Add a quantile-based probing mechanism to detect token-saturation conditions on VPC/private workers and wire a graceful-degradation policy that reduces request concurrency or routes to a lower-cost model variant before tail SLOs are violated. This ticket focuses on the probe logic, the IaC hooks (Terraform module + policy config), dashboards, and an automated canary rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New probe emits token_saturation_score (0-1) computed from sliding-window P50/P95/P99 token throughput vs GPU utilization and KV cache hit ratio; 2) Probe exposes Prometheus metrics and alert rules with annotated quantiles and decision_reason labels; 3) Terraform module updated to allow probe config per VPC deployment and rollout policies; 4) Graceful-degradation policy (concurrency shedding, model-fallback) is exercisable via console or API and documented in runbook; 5) Integration tests that simulate synthetic token pressure validate expected degradations and automatic rollback on recovery.
implementation_plan: 1) Define algorithm: combine rolling quantiles (P50,P95,P99) of tokens/sec per worker with normalized GPU util and kv_cache_hit_rate to compute token_saturation_score; 2) Implement probe in runtime agent (golang) using constant-size reservoir sampling and exponential decay window for quantiles; 3) Expose metric token_saturation_score and token_saturation_components (p50,p95,p99,gpu_util,kv_hit); 4) Build Terraform variable schema changes: module redwood_vpc_probe { token_probe_enabled = bool; probe_policy = string; quantile_thresholds = map }; 5) Add a new policy controller that listens to probe metrics and triggers graceful-degradation actions (adjust concurrency limits, route to model-variant with smaller context window, enable cache-only mode); 6) Add console toggles and API flags; 7) Create rollout plan and canary via terraform workspace + feature flag; 8) Wire Prometheus alerts and dashboard panels for P50/P95/P99 token slopes and decision events.
testing_plan: Unit tests for quantile estimator and score logic; synthetic load e2e using the private-edge test harness to drive token rates while varying kv hits and GPU util; chaos tests to validate that degradation happens within expected SLA envelope; regression tests to ensure probe does not trigger on transient spikes under 15s; load test runs in staging with 10k synthetic streams and compare observed tail latency before/after policy activation.
rollback_plan: 1) Policy controller must include a cooldown and automatic recovery check (score below lower_thres for 60s); 2) Terraform change gated behind feature flag and canary workspace with 5% of traffic diverted; 3) If severity or false-positive rate exceeds threshold, flip feature flag to off and run automated undo terraform apply using saved plan; 4) Postmortem playbook entries created in runbook for manual rollback steps.
notes:
- Prefer quantile summary rather than single-threshold because saturation manifests in P95/P99 before median shifts.
- Use reservoir sampling to keep memory bounded on long-lived workers.
- We should include kv-cache hit-rate because low cache hit amplifies token pressure.
- Coordinate with Dedicated autoscaler team to avoid double-shedding.
- Anticipate small upstream SDK changes to surface decision_reason on responses for debugging.
